item.title: Walking across my Minecraft backups with Plakar
item.description:
TL;DR: I had an AI write a plakar integration to back up Minecraft servers without stopping them, it pauses world saves over RCON while the backup runs and lets players keep digging.

I take short consulting engagements — architecture review, technical due diligence, mail infrastructure — through aljuna.tech.
